speaker: narrator
text: The old lighthouse stood at the edge of the cliff, its lamp dark for the first time in a hundred years.

speaker: companion
text: Someone has to light it tonight. The ships won't know the rocks are there.

speaker: narrator
text: She climbed the spiral stairs two at a time, the wind howling through the broken windows.

speaker: companion
text: I'm almost at the top. Just a little further.
